topPRs.title: Promote develop to staging for Dedicated app recovery
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
Restore the canonical staging release path and deliver the Dedicated history-import routing fix from #31074 so signed-in users can finish opening their Dedicated agent in the Eliza app.

Source: `02ebd209f1b64ca456f6291440f7763caae91b88` (develop). Source tree: `78f88bed92c2119e45ca73265952a2a6207b3ad7`.
Destination before promotion: `e14071f00998f4d10f937015e3060196b991ad4d` (staging).

This promotion includes the accumulated develop changes since September 7, including the existing canonical staging-source policy migration. It is not a two-file hotfix release: the source difference is 1,167 files. The Dedicated fix itself is scoped to the two files reviewed in #31074. No production promotion or production deployment is requested.

Validation:
- #31074 current PR Static Smoke run passed all jobs: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/34655340463.
- The source tree is byte-identical to the locally validated PR tree: full `bun run verify` passed, the focused Cloud route tests passed (19 tests / 206 assertions), Cloud API types and Worker dry-run bundle passed, and the real local Worker/control-plane/PGlite cutover E2E passed. The E2E uses the explicitly configured model substitute and is not a live-model acceptance result.
- Exact merged-source Develop Full is running: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/34655968205. The preceding develop run failed: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/34647456395. No claim of full hosted-green validation is made.
- Before deployment, validate the promotion merge tree, current PR checks, and the canonical Cloud CF Deploy staging gates. Preserve migration, environment, freshness and release-concurrency guards.

Live acceptance still pending: two actual Dedicated chat replies through the local Eliza UI, reload/history continuity, and hosted/mobile sign-in/onboarding checks. Related: #27096, #29024. Shared-agent and Telegram product testing is deferred.

Maintainer release decision: the repository owner explicitly authorized accelerating this Dedicated recovery and proceeding through routine CI waits. The source tree exactly matches the all-green #31074 PR tree and the locally verified tree. The promotion's broader impact smoke and Develop Full runs are still in progress; only the promotion PostgreSQL authority check has completed successfully at this point. Proceed with the promotion for staging integration testing, without labeling unfinished checks green. Canonical migration/environment/freshness guards still apply; production remains separate.

topPRs.title: Preserve durable chat recovery and reduce repeated model context
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
Explicit tool-catalog requests could discover the correct tools, then loop through rejected replies because schema discovery was never evaluated as the requested read. Ordinary navigation also carried broad schemas and repeated policy/history text. This draft fixes the discovery completion path and reduces repeated context while preserving durable memory, source-bound recall, permissions, and reply recovery.

@lalalune — saved for review, still a draft. Related to #17030 and stacked on #31031 (`integrate/stable-20260910`). Combined source checkpoint: `e6b27611cdd`. Extracted draft checkpoint: `80703ad45ce`.

### Included

- Durable post-delivery memory tasks, scoped revision checkpoints/backfill continuation, edited/deleted evidence reconciliation, and recovery of work owned by exited local processes.
- Original dialogue and stable conversation identity survive reply failures. Reply recovery preserves settled effects, failure evidence, requester-bound memory access and source bindings.
- Source-selected history and deferred provider bodies with full permission-checked restoration. Exact repeated dialogue uses lossless references in Stage1, planning and restored completion context. Every source/occurrence remains; no history cap or last-N window.
- Progressive tool families, complete compact discovery indexes, and scoped facts/widgets/notes/experience/skill context. Default and custom planner prompts share complete canonical policies; only missing rules are appended.
- Explicitly requested catalog inspection reaches the ordinary completion evaluator after the real catalog read. Preparatory discovery still proceeds to domain work; discovery never substitutes for domain execution. Preserve DISCOVER_TOOLS hints through early normalization before its later registration. Surface construction retains explicit discovery even when no domain hint resolves or every admitted domain action is selected; otherwise it could silently fall back to broad runtime tools.
- Narrow `VIEWS_SHOW` with destination/step identity delegates to the existing permission, cancellation and originating-client receipt path. Reuse same-turn model judgment only for one-view UI work; keep compound domain/layout operations. A later text backstop cannot add navigation after the model has declined it. Pending create/delete choices cannot change a navigation-only action.
- Typed navigation argument errors allow a corrected successful attempt to resolve the malformed one without an extra failure-summary call. An unrelated read cannot erase a failed effect. Scope-only continuation reuses the verified completion without replay or duplicate evaluation; explicit final scope remains required.
- Experience admission excludes successful metadata keys. Facts extraction targets new current-message assertions, excludes recall-only answers, and retains fictional framing. Existing durable checkpoints/reconciliation remain.

Viewer/trajectory changes are in #31014 and CLI adapter changes in #31054. Private histories, local reports, screenshots and local configuration are excluded.

### Latest navigation and context follow-up

- Reuse a fresh typed Stage-1 navigation-only decision through the existing VIEWS_SHOW executor for a single-intent client-chat DM. Exact current-message binding, fresh authorized catalog and all executor gates remain. Compound requests, optional navigation, voice and uncertain decisions keep normal planning; final confirmation still uses the actual receipt.
- A no-navigation decision stays denied when the model also names the current screen, avoiding a redundant classifier call. Requested destinations have an explicit nonempty-ID schema instruction.
- Use shorter lossless history labels; request each source ID once across the selection categories whose union is retained. No source/history cap. The default non-coding reply-only round has a smaller settled-result prompt while preserving applicable policies, full-context restoration and no-effect recovery. Custom prompts retain their instructions.
- Align the fallback HANDLE_RESPONSE schema with the production contextRequests field so deferred-provider reads remain available.

Fourteen additional foreground turns and ten separate background reviews were captured, including intermediate failures. The latest individual samples were hi: 28,584 input /353 output /1 call /1.177s; open Notes: 37,464 /423 /2 calls /2.770s. The user's preceding Notes baseline was 53,028 /497 /3 calls /4.173s. Original-detail plus correction recall went from 34,723 /1,843 /2 calls /3.372s to 28,568 /480 /1 call /2.401s. Cache/history/reload conditions vary; these are not controlled speed or p95 claims. Exact note read plus Calendar navigation and ordered Notes→Home both completed with no record writes. A separate Notes memory review still cost 9,196 input tokens.

Final combined-source checks: 372 core tests across seven files and 99 navigation tests across two files passed; core and app-control typechecks passed. All 17 changed-file contents match this extraction. The extracted worktree still lacks Vitest dependencies, so its direct test command could not launch; exact-head integration/live acceptance remains pending.

### Real-model evidence from the combined source checkout

This pass captured 33 foreground and 29 separate background runs through `/dev` and the normal app, using Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b. It includes failed intermediate attempts, no-change constraints, a single fixture note creation with unchanged filtered readback, original-detail/correction recall, and ordered Notes→Calendar navigation with delivered receipts.

| Request | Before | Later observed result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Same explicit NOTES catalog request | 8 calls /151,532 input /9.42s | 3 calls /50,905 input /3.77s; only discovery executed |
| Calendar + exact note + old/current recall | 8 calls /243,050 input /12.72s | 4 calls /75,091 input /5.59s; navigation + one matching note read |
| Single Notes navigation | 3 calls /54,065 input /3.20s | 3 calls /52,585 input /4.55s; narrow action |
| Home navigation | 3 calls /53,985 input /2.99s | 3 calls /52,407 input /3.31s; narrow action |
| Greeting | 1 call /26,617 input /1.25s | 1 call /28,649 input /1.54s; long history grew during QA |

These are individual observations with different history, source selection and cache conditions, not p95, TTFT or controlled speed benchmarks. Cached input is included. An intermediate cold-boot run hit Cerebras 429 and used the previously configured fallback; it is excluded from the clean comparison. The final compound retained a new fictional correction and the original detail; recall-only facts=[] while the preceding new correction remained a fact.

Earlier combined-source evidence and durable-memory/recovery coverage remain applicable to the accumulated draft. This pass additionally confirmed full history restoration with 33 exact repeated-occurrence references and no accompanying effects.

### Validation

745 core cases across 11 files and 198 navigation cases across 4 files passed on combined source. Notes 148 cases and the widget-provider test file passed earlier this pass. After replacing `Array.findLast` for a downstream TypeScript target, 96 discovery/pending-scope regressions passed again. Scoped Biome, diff checks and all 157 AGENTS/CLAUDE pairs passed.

Full verification on source `47c133fa679` reached 372/373 tasks. The only failure was three existing NativeSelect visual overrides in unchanged WorkflowTriggerPanel.tsx (same blob `f82ac096a52b7de57cb35ee71d607c7ae27989c1` as the starting source). All 11 subsequent audits passed separately. The final discovery-surface follow-up added two regression cases that failed before the fix; its 258-case Stage1/discovery replay, final core typecheck and scoped checks passed. Full repository verification was not repeated after that four-file follow-up. Node, browser and edge core builds passed during verification.

All 28 changed/new-file preimages matched the extracted draft before cherry-pick; the follow-up’s four preimages also matched, and final content parity was checked afterward. This does not replace exact extracted-head integration/live QA: its worktree has no installed Vitest dependencies; the live evidence above belongs to the combined source checkout.

### Remaining gates and cost targets

- GitHub reports base conflicts. Resolve integration with #31031 and run exact extracted-head verification/live QA before readiness or merge.
- The first handler still carries roughly 42k system characters and about 61k user/context characters in the latest Notes trace, plus its structured tool schema. These are sizes, not additive billed-token attribution; flattened diagnostics duplicate some wire text. Consolidate Stage1 context/routing/field instructions with intent coverage.
- Read-only requests can still select unnecessary note-write schemas; the tested compound did so without executing them. The latest two-view sequence used four calls; the queued second step still incurred an intermediate evaluator. An earlier catalog reply also added imprecise current-view wording despite making no navigation call. Preserve receipt and pending-work checks while improving these selections.
- Further background eligibility/coalescing and large-backfill quota measurements remain. No memory/checkpoint/reconciliation protections were removed.
- Development reload readiness can precede deferred field registration, and repeated runtime reloads left dev counters stale until refresh. Traces remained intact; those lifecycle causes are not claimed fixed.
- Browser-domain, voice, devices, deployment, live export and release acceptance remain separate and deferred.

Closes #24097.

- routes Z.AI Coding Plan, Kimi Coding Plan, DeepSeek API, Z.AI API, Moonshot API, xAI API, and OpenRouter through the surviving `pi-agent` ACP backend
- declares provider dialect, allowlisted endpoint, auth header, default/explicit model, billing mode, and terms policy in one typed table

topPRs.title: fix(ui): preserve host configuration during remote onboarding
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #30988.

Remote onboarding adopts an existing agent by sending only its first-run completion marker through the existing configuration writer; that writer's normal configuration normalization still applies. The connection form now waits for adoption to complete, retains its values on failure, and permits retry. Consecutive native and deep-link connection requests are serialized so an older attempt cannot overwrite a newer selection.

Remote selection keeps status, configuration, chat and account state bound to the selected host. Native local endpoint rotation updates the selected local connection atomically. Both connection entry points accept deployment prefixes and reject URL user information before changing the saved connection. Queued onboarding text stays durable until the mounted composer accepts the complete text.

Remote views retain usable navigation through equivalent registry refreshes. Genuine source or selected-host changes replace their module leases while rejecting old handles; inactive retained views cannot acquire the foreground view’s permissions.

Current integration candidate `d35888044509feebc8ea8e9dd3e78ea4475ea993` is rebased onto develop `77041c39df357b97316339faf188f0473d2e67f5` and changes 44 files relative to that base. Root and independent review compared all 28,860 tree entries against qualified `b706137`: only three test files differ, each exactly matching current develop. All production code, configuration and assets are byte-identical, so the installed b706 native and built-browser evidence remains applicable by source equality. New-head normal installation, all 373 repository verification tasks, 38 affected tests (11 notification RPC, 18 real-PGlite outbox and 9 local-HTTP cache), and the 13-commit secret scan passed. All five exact-head hosted checks passed in [run 34548937732](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/34548937732). The PostgreSQL conditional gate passed with its contract test steps inapplicable; Windows security, billing replay and source lint/type/build executed successfully. The earlier push-triggered run 34548906889 was superseded by ready-for-review and cancelled; its failed aggregate remains historical, not the acceptance run.

- Current pinned normal installation, full repository `bun run verify`, and 13-commit secret scan passed.
- Current integration replay passed 447 tests: 359 UI contracts, 42 native TCP/WebSocket/preload controls, 29 real HTTP/configuration cases and 17 canonical connector first-run cases.
- Final signed macOS QA build and installation passed. All 8,332 selected payload files match the build by SHA-256. Authenticated native status and first-run status both return 200. Interactive native form replay now passed on the installed build: a visible unauthorized attempt retained setup, native token entry and retry connected to the isolated HTTP agent, and the complete Unicode request appeared unsent in the composer. All 8,332 installed payloads and the served renderer manifest were reverified after interaction.
- Actual served-factory browser replay passed all four cases across host, credential and source changes, including a delayed response rejected before evaluation. The current active module remains usable while old handles are rejected. Production Cloud navigation also passed.
- Final built desktop/mobile/cold adoption and actual paused-host retry passed against a fresh isolated runtime process from this source. Desktop/mobile preserve all 20,972 Unicode codepoints (21,622 UTF-16 units); retry preserves all 20,974 codepoints. Failed adoption preserves the full pending batch and configuration; success changes only the first-run marker through the existing writer. All four complete drafts match exactly.
- Current JPGs and four MP4 walkthroughs were inspected. All 17 current assets were read back from GitHub with matching sizes and SHA-256 digests. All five hosted checks for qualified predecessor b706137 passed in run 34542169614. Native interactive acceptance is complete; newer develop test changes were reconciled without altering production source. The conflict is resolved and new-head local integration validation passed; all five hosted checks for the rebased candidate passed in run 34548937732.

Retained broader validation, with its original scope: full agent 774 files plus 9 mobile controls passed; native 1,501 tests passed; App 950 script tests plus 2 existing skips and 1,630 component tests passed. The earlier full UI run had 13,978 passes, 99 failures in two fixtures and 7 skips; the fixtures were repaired and every failed case passed focused replay. Expanded auth/queue/form/notification contracts passed 390 tests. Final scope integration passed 146 controls, canonical importer replay passed 129, and the remaining App compositions passed 30. These full runs are not relabeled as execution on the new merged base; current integration and packaged replay cover its affected contracts.

The reviewed `ff3c7e3` canonical app audit passed 222 cases: 216 findings, no broken or needs-work verdicts; OCR 203 verified and 13 inspected, no regressions. All 21 visual flags and 13 OCR flags were inspected. Character resting overlaps matched their predecessor exactly and normal scroll/click/editing controls passed. That audit and the merged consolidation's full app matrix qualify unchanged owners; current Cloud, factory and remote-adoption replay cover this merged build.
